Notes: IMO's MEPC.364(79) table predates a dedicated VLSFO line, so this uses the industry-assessed average NCV instead. Sits ~3% above HSFO and ~3% below LSMGO, as expected for a residual grade between the two on sulphur/paraffinicity.
IMO 'Diesel/Gas Oil' category (ISO 8217 DMX-DMB). Covers LSMGO too - this app treats the two as one product; see data/README.md.
DMB grade falls in IMO's same Diesel/Gas Oil bracket as MGO; permits marginal residual carryover but energy content does not diverge meaningfully.
Native commercial unit is $/MMBtu (JKM); 48.0 GJ/mt = 45.5 MMBtu/mt for conversion. Field figures vary 45-49 GJ/mt by composition - this is the IMO regulatory reference value.

Less than half the energy density of fossil residual/distillate grades - the reason methanol-fuelled vessels carry much larger tank volumes for the same range. MEOH_VLSFOe and MEOH_MGOe (as used in src/lib pricing) are the same physical methanol restated as energy-equivalent prices against VLSFO/MGO, not separate fuels - they share this row's energy content.
